summary.en: Indie labels and major radio briefly share a playlist; loud/quiet becomes default song form.
summary.zh: 独立厂牌与主流电台短暂共用歌单；强弱对比成为默认曲式。

sound.en: Fuzz pedals, soft–loud verse–chorus, dry room mics, alt-radio mixes
sound.zh: Fuzz 效果器、弱–强主歌副歌、干房间话筒、另类电台混音

body.en:
Seattle Sub Pop and related bands hit US MTV and modern-rock radio after Nevermind (1991). Pixies-style soft–loud dynamics become a common template. Radiohead moves from guitar singles toward studio-heavy albums by mid-decade.

This track is US-leaning alternative shock—not the Britpop chart war running in parallel in the UK.
body.zh:
西雅图 Sub Pop 及相关乐队在 Nevermind（1991）之后打进美国 MTV 与现代摇滚电台。Pixies 式的弱–强动态成为常用模板。Radiohead 在十年中期从吉他单曲转向录音室重度专辑。

这条线是偏美的替代冲击——不是英国并行发生的 Britpop 榜单战。
